descriptionChirho: A very large, often innumerable quantity; literally ten thousand but frequently used hyperbolically for an uncountable host. The two clusters differ only in case inflection (accusative/nominative/dative/genitive plural vs genitive plural with adjectival usage). All major translations render both clusters identically: Spanish 'miríadas/de miríadas', Hindi लाखों/करोड़ों (both large-number terms), Arabic رِبْوَات/آلاف, Korean 수만/만, Swahili makumi-elfu/mamilioni. The genitive 'of myriads' in S72589 is a syntactic variant, not a separate meaning. Merging as one sense covering the full declensional paradigm of this cardinal/indefinite numeral.
